newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand set to buy electricity from Burma.
newsitem.headline: Thailand set to buy electricity from Burma.

text.p: Thailand is set to buy 1,500 megawatts of electricity from Burma, starting from the year 2007, a government official said on Tuesday.
He said both sides were scheduled to sign a memorandum of understading here on July 4 with Burma's Energy Minister U Khin Maung Thein representing the country' military government.
According to a government source, Thailand is interested in buying the electricity from six major projects in Burma, all of them hydro power plants.
Two of the projects were invested in by major Thai corporates such as Italian-Thai Development Plc, MDX Plc and Jasmine International Plc.
